scope: Full 90-query development retrieval regression, no answer generation or new judge calls
sparse_candidate: Same BM25 parameters; corpus and query both tokenized with Unicode word regex, retaining internal decimal/dash sequences. No synonym expansion.
normalization_contract: Record original outputs and fidelity errors; candidate validation errors stop retrieval and count as no-hit, not clarification.
C_ablation: Same prompt and ambiguity gate, no query-specific dictionary injection. Shared static prompt guidance retained.
selection_policy: Hit/MRR diagnostics only. No weights selected, no candidate promoted without Context Precision objective and coverage review.
